name: moneyexchange-tv
description: Enterprise Money Exchange Digital Signage & Branch Management System

scripts.build: npm install --prefix web && npm --prefix web run build && rm -rf out && cp -r web/out out
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && npx firebase-tools@latest deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && npm --prefix web run deploy:pages
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build && npx firebase-tools@latest deploy
